Unused Flags

2207 - 2402 and 
2549 - 2728 (not as tested as the ones above)

----------------------------------------------------------------------
Unused Variables

16400-16700

----------------------------------------------------------------------
**These are just our estimations. If you want to make sure a flag or 
variable sin't used in an unedited rom, you will want to open a clean
rom in DSPRE and use the search feature on the script editor. Then
you can use searches like the examples below. Just remember to convert the
flag or variable number you are looking for to hex. As long as no results
are found, then it should be unused.

SetFlag 0xED

SetVar 0x40E7
